issues.note: Dropping the loss makers after seeing results looks like +$247.8M. It is hindsight; allocating on it repeats the loss.

issues.title: Fundamental sleeve fell 37% with no risk budget
issues.note: Sleeve lost $331.6M; a 10% drawdown stop and vol targeting cap it near $125M.

issues.title: Costs of $184.7M on $91bn traded
issues.note: Lower turnover and better execution cut about 40% of costs.

issues.title: Half the news move is gone before the daily fill: should we go faster?
issues.note: Running the same signal on real-time news lost $65.5M more. Speed only pays once the signal works; the right call is not to build it yet.

issues.title: HFT sleeve is not co-located: -9.18% that becomes +11.02%
issues.note: The co-located scenario turns the $100M sleeve from -$9.2M to +$11.0M.

issues.title: Trend sleeve is too big for its capacity
issues.note: Trend makes +3.15% at $10M and -0.18% at $1.5bn; right-sizing is worth about $50M.

issues.title: Find a real, tradable edge (Sharpe 1 at 5% vol)
issues.note: Sharpe 1 at 5% vol on $5bn for 463 sessions. Most researchers never find one.
